title: Nvidia beat earnings — and the stock dropped 3%

beats.narration: Nvidia just posted record earnings — and the stock dropped 3%.
Q1 revenue hit $81.6 billion, up 85% from last year, with data center revenue nearly doubling.
Next quarter's guidance came in at $91 billion, above Wall Street's number. The beat just wasn't big enough — expectations were already priced in.
CEO Jensen Huang said demand has gone parabolic, driven by agentic AI workloads running around the clock.
And Nvidia is now the only platform running every frontier model — OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google Gemini, and xAI all live on its chips.
Its new Vera CPU also opens a $200 billion market, with $20 billion in CPU revenue expected this year alone.
When a perfect quarter still isn't enough, you know how high the bar has gotten. Follow for more.
